name: @pipeworx/mcp-epoch-ai-models

tools.name: ai_model
tools.description: Look up one AI model in Epoch AI's models database by name — organization, release date, parameter count, training-compute (FLOP) estimate, hardware, accessibility. Resolves dated variants (e.g. "GPT-4" matches Epoch AI's "GPT-4 (Mar 2023)" row). An unmatched name returns found:false with the closest names in the dataset, never an empty result.

tools.name: ai_models_search
tools.description: Search/filter Epoch AI's models database by organization, domain (e.g. "Language", "Vision", "Multimodal"), publication year, and/or a minimum training-compute (FLOP) threshold. Returns newest-first, capped at `limit` (default 50) with count/truncated so a large match set is never silently cut.

organization.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on organization name, e.g. "OpenAI"

domain.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on domain, e.g. "Language", "Vision", "Speech"

year.description: Restrict to models published in this calendar year

min_compute.description: Minimum training compute in FLOP, e.g. 1e25

query.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on model name

limit.description: Max rows to return, default 50, max 200

tools.name: ai_compute_trend
tools.description: Yearly training-compute trend from Epoch AI's models database: for each year, the number of models with a compute estimate, the largest training run (FLOP) that year, and which model set it. Optionally filtered by domain and a starting year.

domain.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on domain, e.g. "Language"

from_year.description: Earliest calendar year to include, default 2010

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-epoch-ai-models forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the epoch-ai-models pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
